summary: Iteration 23 retested the iteration 22 issues (frontend only, 390x844). Flow: TRUCK2026 -> skip onboarding -> 'Take me to Pilot Travel Center Lodi CA' -> parking-satellite-thumb. HIGH (first-pinch origin): FIXED. I opened the modal and waited for the slide-in to end (map rect top went 844 -> 0 in about 250 ms), plus 300 ms. The FIRST pinch over E (parking-sat-spot-entry-0), 60 -> 160 px, moved E by (0.0, 0.0). The pinch back in moved it by (0.0, 0.0). There was no resize first. An off-centre pinch at (80,450) put E at (476.1,124.25) vs an expected (476.1,124.2), and the reverse pinch returned E to its exact start. MEDIUM (native page zoom): FIXED. The map root's computed touch-action is 'none' (from the component; I injected no CSS). visualViewport.scale stayed 1 after every pinch and window.scrollY stayed 0. REGRESSION: all pass. Wheel zoom over E: in moved E by (0,0.1) and out by (0,0). Wheel at the off-centre point (60,120) gave the exact expected position. Mouse drag (page zoom 1) and touch drag both gave exactly -100/-80. The +/- buttons zoom exactly about the map centre and are 44x44. The X and the footer both close the modal. route-to-entry 'Route ends at truck entrance' is shown for Pilot Lodi. No console errors or warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: ParkingSatMap.tsx:107-115 measures the origin with getBoundingClientRect at pinch start, the same way the wheel handler does. That is correct.
ParkingSatMap.tsx:232: touchAction 'none' on the root passes through react-native-web (computed style 'none') and blocks browser pinch-zoom.
A pinch started DURING the ~250 ms slide-in would use the moving rect. This is not tested and is negligible in practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For pinch, use a CDP session: Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled(maxTouchPoints 5) + Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Wait for the parking-sat-map rect top to reach 0 (slide-in ~250 ms). Read the E marker centre with getBoundingClientRect. A 60->160 px pinch = +1 zoom (rounded log2).
